subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should OpenClaw treat current history/queue/Stop reconnect mitigation as sufficient, or add first-class active WebChat run identity adoption across WebSocket reconnects?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses Gateway protocol/session state and Control UI lifecycle semantics, and the only direct PR is stale, blocked, and not safe for automation to choose as the permanent contract.

options.title: Define active-run adoption
options.body: Land a current-main protocol/UI contract that restores active run identity across reconnects and prove it with a real WebChat reconnect flow.

options.title: Revive PR #41067
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase it onto current main, use current filtered active-run contracts, resolve review findings, and add live proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide history refresh, in-flight projection, queued-send retry, and Stop visibility satisfy the supported behavior.

recommendation.title: Define active-run adoption
recommendation.body: Land a current-main protocol/UI contract that restores active run identity across reconnects and prove it with a real WebChat reconnect flow.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the closest merged reconnect mitigation for preserving Stop from active session-run state when local run id is gone.
